name: Mail2Rust Studio Desktop
description: Universal offline email and mailbox migration suite in pure Rust with zero-Outlook PST generation, forensic eDiscovery, dual Win32/Iced desktop GUIs, and stdio MCP server.
majorCapabilities: 64-bit Unicode [MS-PST] binary container reader, writer & validator (zero Outlook COM)
15+ mailbox formats, IMAP/TLS, IMAP-to-IMAP sync & JMAP RFC 8620/8621
Outlook & Office diagnostics (NK2Edit, OutlookAttachView, OutlookStatView, OutlookAddressBookView, OfficeIns)
Forensic Bates stamping, SHA-256 Merkle roots & eDiscovery regex search
15-tool MCP JSON-RPC stdio server with read-only/mutating policy gates
